profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Jam City
profile.summary:
I'm a centered focused engineer that likes to tackle problems with directly and tries to generalize its solutions as much as possible in order to cover a wider variety of issues, and to allow them to be reused latter for similar problems. 

I'm also always looking to make my solutions as efficient as possible and I constantly push myself in order to improve.

My current objective is to participate in high impact products targeted towards end users, and to help create a difference in those projects and through those projects.

On this process I intend to fulfill:
1) Learn new and existing technologies.
2) Participate in the design and creation process of the application and its architecture.
3) Increase my expertise in programming, management and leadership.

positions.description: Working with Rainbow Star Studios under Disney.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a senior software engineer I have under my responsibility the design and implementation of the game core components and features, as well as helping to maintain and improve the our existing set of games. 
During my time at HVS I have worked on: Bag It!, Threes Android, Up&Up! and Skullgirls Mobile, with the last two being the most relevant work.

positions.title: Software Engineer At Poker
positions.description:
During my time in the Poker team as a software engineer, I was part of the development of the new Poker app for both Android and iOS, which was built on the Unity3D engine. This task involved the creation of new features for the game including sales features and gameplay features, as well as the maintenance, bug fixing and general support of the app.

During this time I also participated on severañ R&D initiatives including one to do QA UI automation on Android and iOS, for applications based on the Unity3D engine, using Appium framework as an intermediary..

positions.title: Software Engineer At With Friends
positions.description: As a software engineer in the with friends team, I worked on maintaining and improving the Scramble With Friends game for the Android platform. This involved the implementation of new mechanics and features, improving performance and stability and giving maintenance to the game. Most of my work had to deal with the client side of the application and revolved around the use of Java and the ADK to create the new features that engage the players.

positions.title: Gameplay Engineer Intern
positions.description: As a Gameplay Engineer I develop gameplay features, backend systems and hardware plugins for different projects. I work on a team with other developers and artists, developing for the Unity engine, using C# and C++

positions.title: Project manager
positions.description: I have been working on a project called Autonomous Virtual Patient (AVP) which is being developed in a joint effort with the USC Dentistry School. So far, I have done the software architecture design, helped develop the NLP component of the application, distributed and managed tasks between team members, give assistance with programming problems, and kept up the documentation for the project.

company.name: University of Southern California ITS: CST

positions.title: Jr Developer and R&D
positions.description: During my stance at Wizard3D I was part of several projects, most of them were designated as potential promotional games or applications, and others where done in order to research mechanics for future games and to create a library of mechanics to be used on other games. My main projects were: A labyrinth building game, a third person shooter with mob AI, a physics mobile game similar to the pinball but combined with problem solving, a prototype for human interaction through movement and motion prior to the public commercialization of kinect, and a sound system for the company game engine.

projects.title: ATOM
projects.description: ATOM is a system designed to do QA UI automation for applications build in Unity for mobile devices, that levers Appium as an intermediary system to communicate between the Unity app and the automation software

projects.title: Zynga Poker Classic
projects.description: Zynga Poker Classic is the reimplementation and resurrection of the classical version of Zynga Poker. On this game players can join open tables to play games of Poker Texas Hold'em, or join in game Poker Tournaments.
